# Thunderbird Mail Interface Description

## System and Window Header

- **Operating System**: Linux (indicated by the "Activities" button in the top-left corner)
- **Application Title Bar**: "Thunderbird Mail" on the left, "anonym-x2024@outlook.com - Mozilla Thunderbird" in the center
- **System Time**: "Oct 22 21:43" displayed in the top-center
- **System Tray Icons**: Located in the top-right corner, including network, sound, and power icons
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons on the top-right of the Thunderbird window

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Options**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Options, Tools, Help
- **Quick Action Buttons**: Send, Encrypt, Spelling (with dropdown), Save (with dropdown), Contacts
- **Attachment Button**: "Attach" with a dropdown arrow

## Email Composition Window

### Header Fields

- **From Field**:
  - Displayed as "Anonym Tester <anonym-x2024@outlook.com>"
  - Account dropdown next to it: "anonym-x2024@outlook.com" with a dropdown arrow
- **To Field**:
  - Contains the email address "alexi.riviero@gmail.com"
  - The field is highlighted with a red border, indicating it is currently active or selected
- **Cc and Bcc Fields**:
  - "Cc" and "Bcc" labels are present
  - "Bcc" has a right-pointing arrow (>) next to it

### Subject Field

- **Subject Line**: Empty text field below the "To" field
- **No text has been entered** in the subject line

## Formatting Toolbar

- **Paragraph Dropdown**: "Paragraph" with a dropdown arrow
- **Variable Width Dropdown**: "Variable Width" with a dropdown arrow
- **Text Formatting Icons**:
  - Left Align
  - Center Align
  - Right Align
  - Bold (B)
  - Italic (I)
  - Underline (U)
  - Strikethrough
  - Font Color
  - Background Color
  - List (Bulleted and Numbered)
  - Indent/Outdent
  - Insert Image
  - Smiley (emoji) icon

## Email Body Area

- **Blank Text Area**: Large white space for composing the email body
- **No text has been entered** in the body

## Sidebar (Left Panel)

- **Application Icons**:
  - Chrome browser
  - Thunderbird Mail (active)
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help (question mark)
  - Trash

## Main Thunderbird Interface (Background)

- **Search Bar**: Located at the top, with a magnifying glass icon
- **Account Settings**: Located in the top-right corner, with a user icon
- **Feature Buttons**: "Message filters", "End-to-end Encryption"
- **Quick Access Buttons**: "Filelink", "Feeds", "Newsgroups"
- **Donation Message**: "Thunderbird is funded by users like you! If you like Thunderbird, please consider making a donation. The best way for you to ensure Thunderbird remains available is to make a donation."
  - "make a donation" is a hyperlink
- **Footer**: "Documentation" link
- **Logo**: A faint outline of a bird (Thunderbird logo) in the bottom-right corner

## Status Bar

- **Status Indicator**: "Done" at the bottom-left corner, with a small icon next to it
